svg.data-power-current-max: 10.6 A at 100 VAC; 4.8 A at 240 VAC
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: hardware guide, Uplink Ports: the six uplink ports take SFP and SFP+ transceivers. A Virtual Chassis can be formed with SFP+ and not with SFP

g.data-description: Table 5 - MGT: green steady, Junos OS loaded; green blinking, booting; unlit, powered off or halted
g.title: led-mgt

g.data-description: Table 5 - FAN: green steady, the fans are working; amber blinking, at least one fan has failed; unlit, no alarm or powered off
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: Table 5 - PW: green steady, the power supply is working; amber blinking, PoE power to the ports is disabled; unlit, powered off
g.title: led-pw

g.data-description: Table 9 - ACT: green blinking, the port and the link are active and there is link activity; unlit, no link
g.title: led-act

g.data-description: Table 8 - LINK: green steady, the port and the link are active; unlit, link not active
g.title: led-link
